load.label: load restores the saved state exactly

rounds.text: "Twenty sacks, mill to bakery, before dusk. Five coins." He chalks your name on the board.

arguments.title: Haul flour for the mill
arguments.description: Twenty sacks of flour from the mill to the bakery before dusk.

meet-miller.note: The miller is met and recorded as a character; the mill as a place.

rounds.text: The lane ends at the mill. "Oswin," the miller says, not offering a floury hand. "You're the organiser's hands? Sacks are by the door."

arguments.name: Oswin the miller
arguments.description: The village miller, broad and floury.

arguments.name: The village mill
arguments.description: A stone mill by the brook.

rounds.text: He goes back to his grindstone.
By late afternoon every sack is in the bakery's storeroom.
The organiser strikes it off the board.
Carts roll through; a dog sleeps in the shade of the well.
"Dry summer," the organiser says. "Good for roads, bad for mills."

return.note: The same miller: the existing record is updated (present again), never duplicated.

rounds.text: Oswin looks up from the grindstone as you come down the lane again.
"Back for more sacks, or just the view?"
